tokens.name: ui-primary
tokens.usage: Primary actions, links, focus ring, active state. Light: azure-700 (Nuxt default is 500, which is 3.6:1 on white; 700 keeps soft and subtle variants above 4.5:1).

tokens.name: ui-secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary emphasis: secondary buttons, tags, highlights. Light: aqua-800.

tokens.name: ui-success
tokens.usage: Success state. Always with an icon and a word. Light: jade-800.

tokens.name: ui-info
tokens.usage: Informational notices (shares the cyan ramp with secondary). Light: aqua-800.

tokens.name: ui-warning
tokens.usage: Warning state. Always with an icon and a word. Light: ochre-800.

tokens.name: ui-error
tokens.usage: Errors, destructive actions, invalid fields. Light: garnet-700.

tokens.name: ui-text-dimmed
tokens.usage: Placeholders, disabled labels. Raised from Nuxt's neutral-500 so placeholders pass 4.5:1 on bg and elevated. Light: steel-500 (placeholders on the white input ground, 4.8:1).

tokens.name: ui-text-muted
tokens.usage: Metadata, captions, timestamps, helper text on --ui-bg and --ui-bg-elevated. Light: steel-600 (one step darker than Nuxt so it holds on --ui-bg-elevated).

tokens.name: ui-text-toned
tokens.usage: Secondary body copy, table cells, sidebar items. Light: steel-700.

tokens.name: ui-text
tokens.usage: Default body copy on --ui-bg, --ui-bg-muted, --ui-bg-elevated. Light: steel-800 (one step darker than Nuxt for long reading).

tokens.name: ui-text-highlighted
tokens.usage: Headings, emphasized values, active labels. Off-white instead of pure white to limit glare in long reading. Light: steel-900.

tokens.name: ui-text-inverted
tokens.usage: Text on solid primary, secondary, status fills and --ui-bg-inverted. Light: white, labels on solid fills.

tokens.name: ui-bg
tokens.usage: Page canvas. Light: white.

tokens.name: ui-bg-muted
tokens.usage: In-flow raised areas: sidebars, toolbars, table headers. Light: steel-50.

tokens.name: ui-bg-elevated
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, popovers, modals (overlays add a shadow). Light: steel-100.

tokens.name: ui-bg-accented
tokens.usage: Hover and selected rows, chips, skeletons. Light: steel-200.

tokens.name: ui-bg-inverted
tokens.usage: Tooltips and inverted callouts. Light: steel-900.

tokens.name: ui-border
tokens.usage: Faint hairlines: dividers, card outlines on --ui-bg. Decorative only. Light: steel-200.

tokens.name: ui-border-muted
tokens.usage: Dividers on elevated surfaces; overlay outlines. Light: steel-300.

tokens.name: ui-border-accented
tokens.usage: Control outlines (inputs, selects, checkboxes, outline buttons). Raised from Nuxt's neutral-700 to meet 3:1. Light: steel-500 (3:1 control outline; Nuxt default 300 is 1.5:1).

tokens.name: ui-border-inverted
tokens.usage: Borders on inverted surfaces. Light: steel-900.

spacing.note: Tailwind 4 spacing: every utility is a multiple of --spacing (0.25rem). The named steps are the ones layouts should reach for.

tokens.name: spacing
tokens.usage: Tailwind base unit (--spacing). p-1 = 4px.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between icon and label; tight stacks (gap-2).

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Control padding, list item padding (p-3).

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on mobile; form field stacks (p-4, gap-4).

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop; paragraph-to-heading gap (p-6).

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between page sections inside a column (gap-8).

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between major page regions (py-12).

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Hero and page-top padding (py-16).

tokens.name: ui-radius
tokens.usage: Nuxt UI base radius (--ui-radius). Components multiply it.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, badges (rounded-md = --ui-radius × 1.5).

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, popovers, modals (rounded-lg = --ui-radius × 2).

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Avatars, switches, pill tags only.

shadow.note: Shadows only for surfaces that float over the canvas. In-flow surfaces show elevation by color (bg → bg-muted → bg-elevated) and faint borders. Dark shadows are deeper so they read on the dark canvas.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Dragged items, sticky headers once scrolled.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Dropdown menus, popovers, tooltips, select menus.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Slideovers, drawers, toasts.

tokens.name: shadow-xl
tokens.usage: Modals and command palette.
